thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-03 has one dated macro item ('Job openings inch up as hiring slows, affirming labor market stability') that is mildly reassuring but not a strong, differentiated catalyst; the rest is single-name/ETF-comparison commentary (Nvidia bull case, dividend-stock picks, ETF flow tables, crypto price roundups) and routine politician PTR filings, none actionable for a diversified core-ETF sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.6 of ~107.6 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on a single soft macro data point, consistent with capital preservation.
